what: A 7-voice analogue-style polysynth in the manner of the Sequential Prophet-6: two oscillators with continuously variable shape, hard sync and a sub-octave, a high-pass into a self-oscillating 4-pole low-pass, the classic POLY MOD, VINTAGE voice character (SELECT), VOICE SPREAD (ALGORITHM), distortion, BBD chorus, room/hall/plate/spring reverbs and SPACE, an ambient reverb after the Mercury7. A 16-bar polyphonic step sequencer, an arpeggiator, MIDI clock in.
author: swtdr34mz
